_comment: Independent public-input witness for dothrow.c dofire() (dothrow.c:543-571): a Ranger wields her arrows, empties the quiver and fires; doquiver_core() readies the wielded stack, which unwields it and takes a move, and fireassist finds the bow as the alternate weapon, queues #swap and #fire and returns that ECMD_TIME, so the turn passes before the queued commands run.
